comment: Key every green-screen plate in plates/ on your ComfyUI (the CorridorKey 2.0 node pack there, an NVIDIA card of the RTX 30 generation or newer) and save each key as a PNG in keys/, the matte as its transparency. Run it while Scumble is open and connected to that ComfyUI: --run drives the open Scumble. From the folder that holds plates/: Scumble --run key_folder.json (docs/MCP.md, Batches).

steps.comment: a tab of its own: the run never changes the documents you have open
